description: Hanaro parser and semantic handling policies (production-ready)

input_validity_policy.description: Guard rules to prevent accidental over-classification and role collision
rules: A line matched by hanaro/discount_patterns.json must not be classified as item_detail or item_name unless the matched store_role is explicitly item_detail.
A line matched by hanaro/summary_patterns.json must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.
A line matched by hanaro/noise_patterns.json header or strict notice patterns must not be classified as item_detail or item_name.
Bracket-tag lines must not be treated as noise before item_name and discount checks fail.
Noise must always be applied only after item, discount, and summary checks fail.

code_policy.description: Hanaro item and discount code handling rules
notes: discount_detail에서는 c8806163190310 같은 영문 prefix 포함 코드 허용
번호 prefix(001*)는 code 일부가 아니라 item 번호로 보고 분리 가능

apply_only_when: line is already classified as item_detail
code and amount-like fields are confidently extracted
line does not match discount_detail or receipt_discount structure

notes: qty=1 보정은 item_detail 패턴이 확정된 뒤에만 적용
discount_detail, receipt_discount, 일반 텍스트 라인에는 적용하지 않음

amount_policy.description: Amount normalization and casting rules for Hanaro
notes: negative amount는 item discount일 수도 receipt_discount일 수도 있으므로 line_type 확정 전 의미를 고정하지 않음
대괄호 내부는 보조 정보 또는 태그로 보고 상품명 후보에서 제거 가능
COB 같은 영문 prefix는 비의미 prefix인 경우 제거 가능

line_classification_policy.description: Recommended order for Hanaro line classification
rules: summary lines must be checked before generic noise rules
receipt_discount must win over discount_detail when known global discount keywords appear
discount_detail must win over item_name when negative amount structure exists
noise must be applied only as the final fallback

parser_rules: parser must distinguish item-level discount_detail from receipt_discount
parser must preserve discount_label_raw when present
parser must not attach discount lines to items
semantic_rules: most item-level discounts attach to the previous eligible item
receipt_discount lines such as 끝전할인, 쿠폰할인, 총할인액 must remain separate from item discounts
global discount lines that look item-like should still be resolved using full context

receipt_discount_policy.description: Global or receipt-level discount handling rules
parser_rules: receipt_discount lines must remain separate from item-level discount lines
receipt_discount lines must not be attached to a product in parser stage
receipt_discount classification must not override explicit item-level discount_detail structures
semantic_rules: receipt_discount may be used for settlement or final receipt reconciliation
global discount lines require full receipt context before allocation

rules: if an item-section discount and a lower summary discount represent the same amount and same event, prevent double counting
총할인액 is an aggregate reference line and must not be added again as a new item discount

examples.case: same discount appears in item section and bottom summary

notes: dedupe is not a parser responsibility
parser should preserve all discount candidates for downstream resolution

rules: sum(final_price) should be reconcilable with receipt total
쿠폰할인 + 이벤트할인 + 끝전할인 may be compared against 총할인액 when applicable
notes: validation is downstream and should not change parser classification
총할인액 can be used as a consistency check, not as an item-level discount source

required: strip leading star prefix when appropriate
strip item number prefix for name candidates
normalize spaced keywords such as 끝 전할 인 -> 끝전할인
preserve bracket tags in raw text before name normalization
forbidden: do not remove bracket tags from raw line_text before semantic handoff
do not attach discount lines to items in parser stage
do not compute final_price in parser stage

requirements: all lines must be returned, including noise lines
final line_type must use common line type enum
store_role may be preserved for debugging and semantic handoff

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: dedupe_resolution
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: 중복 할인 제거는 semantic/validation 단계에서 수행

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: multi_line_item_object_creation
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: item_name + item_detail 결합은 semantic 단계에서 수행

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: final_price_calculation
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: 최종 가격 계산은 semantic 단계에서 수행

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: misclassifying_discount_or_summary_as_item
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: discount, summary, item 간 충돌은 parser 단계에서 분리되어야 한다

implementation_notes: Hanaro 기본 상세라인 순서는 code + unit_price + qty + total_price
code 길이 범위가 넓고 barcode-like 구조가 흔하다
item-level discount와 receipt_discount가 혼재하므로 둘을 반드시 분리해야 한다
총할인액은 집계 라인이므로 개별 item discount로 사용하면 안 된다
